[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Victor Alade, Tax Manager (senior).
Tax manager: runs the return workflow, the review queue, the extension list, and the R&D credit study. First escalation point for every tax question in the building.
Personality: Fast, organized, keeps three lists and trusts none of them. Protective of his staff's evenings outside season.

Working hours: 08:00-18:00

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Gabriel, Victor,

I was reviewing the monthly close package and one line item caught my attention. I’d like a quick clarification before we sign off.

Could you let me know what drove the movement in the [specific line item – insert name/reference if known, otherwise leave as placeholder]? I want to make sure we’re reflecting the right picture, and if there’s a supporting document, please send it over.

Just a one-line explanation will do for now – happy to loop in a call if that’s easier.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Hi Dana,

Thanks for flagging this. The movement in that line item is driven by three things:

1. Product mix – a higher share of lower-margin SKUs this quarter
2. Freight – a one-off carrier rate increase that hit in August
3. Pricing – two volume discounts that were applied mid-quarter

There was also a one-time inventory write-off that we separated out so it doesn’t distort the trend.

I can send over the supporting schedule if that helps – just say the word.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Gabriel,

Thanks for the breakdown—that's helpful. Could you send over the supporting schedule for the write-off as well? I want to make sure the separation is clean in our records before we sign off.

Also, can you confirm the August freight rate increase was a one-off, or should we expect it to carry into September? One line is fine.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Hi Dana,

Attached is the supporting gross margin schedule you asked for. It breaks down the line item by product mix, freight, pricing, and the one-off inventory write-off (shown separately so it doesn't distort the trend).

On the August freight rate increase: that was a one-off carrier adjustment and does not carry into September. We've locked in the rate for the remainder of the quarter.

One note—Victor is confirming the two volume discounts on his end before we finalize, so I'll flag if anything shifts.

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes
